correctness.rationale: The minimax completion lemma is proved by a lower bipartite path-forest bound and an exhaustive three-case left-to-right adversarial labeling induction; it yields necessary and sufficient trace extendibility at every n,k,S. Binomial gaps count every face. Pure skeleton follows from minimum domination size of maximal path independent sets, and classical vertex-decomposability plus nonpure-skeleton shellability imply an equidimensional sphere wedge; Euler characteristic fixes the integral rank. Standalone exhaustive checker confirms 1,004,886 trace cases, 1,595 minimax instances, and homology over two primes for 28 cases. Finite checks are not taken as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Exact fixed-weight path sampling is a natural constrained set system; the new minimax completion identity resolves all 2^|S| trace feasibility uniformly, not merely its maximum dimension. The all-degree face enumerator plus pure shellable wedge decomposition gives explicit torsion-free homology groups for an infinite two-parameter family, including unbounded top sphere dimension and ranks. The proof isolates a nontrivial interaction of exact cardinality, forbidden adjacency and shattering rather than arbitrary small cases or a renamed textbook count.
